title: Run history
empty: Your randomized worlds will be listed here.
regenerateHint: The generated files were cleaned up. This creates the same world again.
removeOldHint: Removes worlds made by older generation profiles (except the one that is applied).
buildHint: The application version and the generation profile this world was made with.
legacyHint: This world was made by an older generation profile. Its Seed Code is still valid and recreates the same world.
deleteApplied: This world is applied to the game. Restore the original files first, then delete it.

dialog.safety: This does not uninstall the application, does not change your Dark Souls saves and does not change the installed game files. Shared data (the copy of the original files, world data, settings) stays.
dialog.clearBody: History entries to remove: {{count}}. Their diagnostic files go with them (generated packages, spoiler, hints, Solver route and manifest).
dialog.oldBody: Entries from older generation profiles to remove: {{count}}, with their diagnostic files. Worlds of the current profile stay.
dialog.protected: The applied world is kept (entries: {{count}}), because the game uses it now and Restore may need it.
dialog.orphans: Folders left by failed or interrupted generations will be removed too: {{count}}.
dialog.deleteTitle: Delete this world from the history?
dialog.deleteBody: This entry and the diagnostic files of this one world (package, spoiler, hints, Solver route) will be removed. Other worlds are not touched.
dialog.failed: Could not delete. Nothing was changed.
